title: IMMunological resPonse Assessment afteR Acute iSchemic Stroke Treated With Endovascular Therapy (IMPRESS)
official: IMMunological resPonse Assessment afteR Acute iSchemic Stroke Treated With Endovascular Therapy
summary: IMPRESS study aims to describe the immuno-inflammatory and thrombo-inflammatory profiles during the first 24/36 hours of treatment of patients suffering from AIC treated with TM, and to study the possible impact of these profiles on the functional prognosis at 3 and 12 months of AIC treatment.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient with an acute ischemic stroke for which treatment with mechanical thrombectomy is indicated, whether or not thrombectomy is performed,
* Having received informed information about the study and having signed a consent to participate in the study (if this is not possible: information and consent of the trusted support person or family member if present; emergency inclusion if absent);
* Affiliated or beneficiary of a social security scheme or equivalent.

Non inclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant or breast-feeding women
* Patient benefiting from a legal protection measure

Exclusion Criteria:

None.
